_method: Every Kanto script in quetzal_rip was paired with its pokefirered counterpart (seeds: map script tables by type, object events at the same index and x/y, bg/coord events at the same x/y; then goto/call/text label arguments at aligned positions, recursively, including data/scripts/*.inc). Paired scripts were aligned command by command with difflib on opcode names after expanding FRLG macros (giveitem/finditem, goto_if_defeated, famechecker, set_gym_trainers, goto_if_questlog, setworldmapflag->setflag). A FLAG_QZ/VAR_QZ operand and a FLAG_/VAR_ operand at the same argument of the same command in an equal-opcode block count as one vote; object-event 'flag' fields of objects at the same index and x/y also vote. 'flags'/'vars' keep every QZ id with at least one vote (majority wins; 'evidence' lists vote counts and the only conflicts). Two spurious single votes were dropped ('dropped'). Cross-check: sorted by QZ number, the mapped FRLG names come out in alphabetical order inside 0x2109-0x232A and 0x5100-0x5145 (Quetzal laid FRLG's flags/vars out alphabetically; 0x2100-0x2108 = 8 badges + FLAG_SYS_GAME_CLEAR, 0x226B+ = item-ball/hide flags restarting the alphabet, VAR_STARTER_MON appended at 0x5147). 'inferred_by_alphabetical_order' fills gaps only where the number of unmapped QZ ids between two aligned anchors equals the number of unmapped FRLG names alphabetically between them: NOT alignment-backed, verify before use. Trainer flags and hidden-item flags are not here: hidden items keep FRLG's hidden-item ids (183/183 bg hidden_item entries carry FRLG's FLAG_HIDDEN_ITEM_* offset from FLAG_HIDDEN_ITEMS_START in their 'flag' field, printed by the rip as 0 / FLAG_TEMP_n / FLAG_QZ_0xNN), and Kanto trainer flags are the trainer ids themselves (checktrainerflag 0x22E7 = TRAINER_QZ_8935).

dropped.FLAG_QZ_0xA79: aligned once with FLAG_SYS_POKEDEX_GET, but Quetzal sets 0xA79 AND 0x226A there; 0x226A is the Kanto copy (aligned), 0xA79 is a cross-region flag outside the Kanto block
dropped.FLAG_QZ_0x2EB4: FRLG uses FLAG_TEMP_2 at that spot (Resort Gorgeous house); Quetzal uses a permanent flag of its own

non_kanto_ids_seen_in_kanto_scripts.FLAG_QZ_0xA79: set in Oak's lab with the POKéDEX (only if unset): a dex flag shared by all regions (inference)
non_kanto_ids_seen_in_kanto_scripts.FLAG_QZ_0xA78: set with 0xA79 when the starter is received (inference: shared 'has a Pokémon/starter' flag)
non_kanto_ids_seen_in_kanto_scripts.VAR_QZ_0x4087: Two Island Joyful Game Corner reads it like VAR_CABLE_CLUB_STATE; 0x4087 is pokeemerald's VAR_CABLE_CLUB_STATE (Quetzal is Emerald-based)

qz_specials_note: QZ_SPECIAL_n whose call site aligns with a pokefirered special (votes from the same alignment). QZ_SPECIAL_737 is left out: it sits where FRLG calls QuestLog_CutRecording, famechecker's SetFlavorTextFlagFromSpecialVars and help-context specials (likely a stub). Stock special names in the current rip were shifted by one entry when this was made, so no stock-name mapping is given.

map_names_notes.Kanto_CinnabarIsland_Extra1: 52x20, entered from Kanto_PokemonMansion_B1F warp 1 at (31,2); Emerald tilesets and MUS_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN; MAXIE (TRAINER_QZ_8935) and ARCHIE (TRAINER_QZ_8936) guard Groudon and Kyogre and give the Red / Blue Orb
map_names_notes.Kanto_CeruleanCave_Extra1: 19x25, entered from Kanto_CeruleanCave_2F warp 6 at (4,3); one overworld Rayquaza (Quetzal_EventScript_840FBBD), no scripts.inc of its own

map_name_corrections._note: The rip's names for group 38 maps 112-116 are shifted by one: Quetzal dropped FRLG's SevenIsland_UnusedHouse (not SevenIsland_House_Room1). Proof: sizes, layouts (114 uses the Mart layout, 115/116 the Pokémon Center 1F/2F layouts), objects and warps all match the FRLG map one slot earlier in the list. maps/index.json frlg_maps_not_in_quetzal should list SevenIsland_UnusedHouse instead of SevenIsland_House_Room1.
